items.title: Publish and evolve the 2026-02-01 Recovery Services APIs
items.summary: Adds stable 2026-02-01 to both RecoveryServices version enums and applies versioned removals across RecoveryServicesBackup models, properties, unions, and variants. The two projects project 88 operations into the new version, with 86 version-scoped contract differences from stable 2026-01-01.

documents.selectionRationale: Covers versioned API changes and ordering for the referenced Versions member.

guidance.excerpt: TypeSpec uses a versioning library that models the changes in each new version of the API, rather than having a separate API description for each api-version.

documents.title: Add stable after stable
documents.selectionRationale: Covers a stable-after-stable release and the required versioning decoration for API changes.

guidance.excerpt: When the latest api-version in your TypeSpec spec is a stable version, adding a new stable version is simply adding any new types and operations in the new stable and marking them with the appropriate versioning decoration.

documents.title: Evolving APIs
documents.selectionRationale: Directly documents removing an operation in a later version with @removed.

guidance.excerpt: To remove models, properties, or operations starting from a specific version, use the `@removed` decorator. The `version` argument is the version where the element is removed.

documents.title: Decorators
documents.selectionRationale: Documents decorator placement and arguments for the changed @removed operation decoration.

guidance.excerpt: Decorators are referenced using the `@` prefix and must be placed before the entity they are decorating. Arguments can be provided by using parentheses, similar to function calls in many programming languages.

documents.title: Versioning overview
documents.selectionRationale: Covers version enum ordering for the two new 2026-02-01 stable projections.

guidance.excerpt: The `@azure-tools/typespec-azure-resource-manager/version-progression` linter rule helps enforce that every api-version uses a unique `YYYY-MM-DD` date and that versions are declared in strictly increasing chronological order from top to bottom of the `Versions` enum.

documents.title: Add stable after stable
documents.selectionRationale: Directly matches publishing a stable version after stable and removing types in that version.

guidance.excerpt: Add a new version to the `Versions` enum in your spec for the new stable api-version. If any types are removed in this stable, mark these with an `@removed` decorator referencing the new version.

documents.title: Evolving APIs
documents.selectionRationale: Documents versioning decorators for removed models, properties, and operations.

guidance.excerpt: To remove models, properties, or operations starting from a specific version, use the `@removed` decorator. The element will not be present in that version or any later versions.
